ChordSeqAI model assets (recurrent_net weights + chord vocabulary)
================================================================
Source project: https://github.com/PetrIvan/chord-seq-ai-app
Related research/code: https://github.com/StudentTraineeCenter/chord-seq-ai
License: MIT (see below)

The bundled `chordseqai_weights.bin` was exported from the publicly distributed
`recurrent_net.onnx` model. The vocabulary (`chordseqai_vocab.json`) is derived
from `token_to_chord.ts` and `chord_to_notes.ts` in the same project.

Used offline-only for next-chord suggestions inside Chords Theory Enhanced.
No network calls are made at runtime.
